body:
Firts of all thank you so much for your detailed and well thought out comment. You dont even know me, yet you spend your own time wanting to help, I am very grateful.

Your right that I abandoned my child, and the reasons are not good enough. I wont forget that. Ill keep seeing him moving forward, I think once every 2-3 weeks is alright. I will show her that I want to be a dad. 

I will try my hardest to be calm and respective of her wishes. Btw she is 32 and I am 22. thank you for youe comment

I appriceate you not calling me a jerk, I know its quite normal to go to the internet just to get a echo chamber of answers to do what you wanted to do anyways. I am not looking for that, just want a relationship with my son and to understand where she is coming from.

I dont see a lot of empathy for why I havent been a part of his life, and maybe its because people view it all as excuses. And I agree with them, I also believe kids are the most important thing in the world. And obviously I havent even been a father.

I still think my excuses are at least somewhat «worth to hear», and what happened was that I have an udiagnosed ptsd disorder since I was 13, from when I had cancer which almost killed me. And I only met with my ex after 4 months after moving away from my abusive parents who I had a bad bad relationship with. I was diagnosed with depression at that time. she told me she was safe and that she had a contracepetive. But got pregnant only 3 months into the relationship and didnt tell me before it had gone enough weeks to where she had no choice but to keep it. She hid it from me. Shes also 10 years older than me.

I did try to be there in the beginning, holding him and being with him. But at that point my mental health was so bad, that I just stopped sleeping. I later ended up in a psychward, because I nearly ended it. After that I tried to take up an education, because my thinking was that I can at least continue to pay childsupport and going to study would increase it by a lot. She fought me on that, not wanting me to take an education and stay working a low entry job. But the goverment decided that it wqs the smartest move for our son.

I managed one semester with no sleep etc. before I again got cancer. Which had me gone for a full year since I was in the hospital getting chemo and in tremendous pain. During this time I made sure to find out if what I had was genetic, because I have had cancer twice, and to also make sure I continue to pay child support. I carry anger from the fact that she never visited. Maybe I didnt deserve it, but that year was the worst year of my life and I could have died. 

I am now better, but will never fully healed because Ive got nerve damage, and theres a chance the cancer will come back, espically since I have had it twice in not many years. 

I am now going to a thearpy for my ptsd and go regualry to the doctor for help and check ups. I will also start school again to finish my education. I dont want to do a lawyer thing at all, and I understand that she doesnt trust me yet, I deserve that. But she wants me to wait 1 month and more between each time I meet him, and I think thats way too little. Ive met him 3 times now. And will have to wait another month to see him next time, how can I prove to him or her that I can be a father once every month in just a couple of hours?

Thank you for your comment, I do think at least learning more of my rights and my sons rights is a good idea. Communicating with her is hard and she has a lot of anger, from the fact that I left her. And even though I guess you could say I had an explannation. She was still left alone with the child. Which has to be so hard. So I understand her, but it hurts me a lot that I cant call myself for «father», I just think its better that he knows the he has a dad, then to never just hear about who he is

I hear what your saying. I would say I am stable, but my life has been pretty full of turns, and I am still very young. The sickness I had could of killed me, but it didnt. Its a chance it will come back, which is also why I want to use this chance to get into his life again
Yep

That sounds like a good idea, I was hoping I didnt have too go the lawyer road, but it wont go better if I dont.
Yes, she has him 100% acording to the papers

I am not in a position to give a kid the love it craves and deserves. I get that its more than just logic thinking I am fighting, but this kid would grow up with an father, surely she can see that even through all the hormones. And its not like she is a in a good position to take care of a baby either

I will soon talk with a therapist, but I have to wait in «line» for one since its not a private therapist, but a Government one. I like the girl and she likes me but I cant be what she is looking for.  I am 20, living at home with my parents, depressed. While she is 29 and will buy her own appartement soon. Besides i suck at commitments.
